name: interactive-grid-pattern
title: Interactive Grid Pattern
description: A grid of square cells that light up under a moving pointer and fade out behind it, leaving a soft trail.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.interactiveGridPattern(q(".mw-interactive-grid-pattern"), tl, 0.2, { width: 80, height: 80, squares: [24, 14], fill: "rgba(196,181,253,0.45)", path: [[0, -60, 300], [2.6, 1980, 820], [3.2, 1980, 820], [5.8, -60, 380]] });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Upstream reacts to the mouse; here `path` lists [t, x, y] points (px in the grid's box) the pointer passes, linear between them.
